title: the live 6890 tooth judges the verdict's name where the berth is absent
intention: chain's live 6890 tooth judges a verdict carrying the live berth's name when that berth is absent, so it reads the same on a box that did not chart 6890cf7e4053.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: test_live_6890_old_verdict_is_refused asserted /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/verdict-20260902T053326-61dcf9791245.json is a file; the berth stands only on the charting box, so the tooth read red. predates_the_build reads only the verdict path's basename (cairn/tools/chain/verdict_contract.py:257).
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box) and Law 5 (berths are instance-space).
how: In test_live_6890_old_verdict_is_refused, judge LIVE_6890 where it is a file; otherwise write an empty file of the same basename to a scratch dir and judge that. The BUILDME crossing is still read from the commons journal.

clauses.claim: test_a_verdict_answers_the_build_it_was_written_after.py is green on akienasus, which holds no 6890 verdict berth
the live 6890 tooth still reds when predates_the_build is hollowed

decisions.text: D1: the 6890 tooth judges the live berth where it stands, else a scratch file of its exact name.

measured.saw: AssertionError: the live 6890 verdict is gone: /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/verdict-20260902T053326-61dcf9791245.json
measured.how: bin/cairn test over the chain proof on akienasus
